final: WITH type_avg AS (SELECT e.type, AVG(1.0 * b.spent / b.amount) AS avg_ratio FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE b.spent IS NOT NULL AND b.amount IS NOT NULL AND b.amount != 0 GROUP BY e.type) SELECT type, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - AVG(avg_ratio) OVER () AS difference_from_mean FROM type_avg ORDER BY type
